name: Admin Batching
title: Batch admin into one daily window.
benefit: Protected peak hours for real work.
subtitle: Schedule Boundary
rationale: Shallow work expands to fill whatever gaps it finds, so containing it to one window protects the hours when focus is highest.

evidence.summary: Reducing interruptions improves primary-task accuracy and shortens the time needed to resume work.

indications: Small administrative tasks interrupt focus blocks throughout the day.
Email and chat are handled reactively as they arrive.
